description: Test truth, independent of the product table and the parser: aerodrome reference points (ARP) for every departure and destination in the 30-OFP private corpus, rounded to 1e-5 degree. WSSS and KJFK are the official values Codex read on 13 Oct 2026 (CAAS eAIP AD 2.2 WSSS 012133.16N 1035921.57E; FAA AIP KJFK 40-38-23.741N 073-46-43.292W). The other 17 are AIP AD 2.2 values as recalled, not re-read; each agrees with the coordinate its OFP prints on the destination row within 0.61 NM.
